openQuestions: Should the make be renamed from 'Tata Motors' to 'Tata', the badge on the cars? The legal company is now Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd.
The safari photo for generation II is the 2019 Geneva Buzzard show car, the European preview of the Safari II. It is not a production Safari. Is that acceptable?
Should tata-magic, tata-magic-iris and tata-winger (passenger microvans/vans) and tata-tl (Telcoline pickup, sold in Europe) stay in the 'auto' section? They were kept for now.
Has the Xenon/Yodha really ended in export markets? No dated 2026 source was found.
summary: The make entry points at the post-demerger truck company (Q188514, founded 2024) instead of the car maker (Q7687819, founded 1945). The model list has 12 non-car or duplicate entries. In the cards, the Indica first-generation end year was fixed (2008 -> 2018) and a non-specific Nano photo was replaced. The 2026 events checked (Punch facelift Jan 2026, Tiago facelift May 2026, Tigor -> Aeris Sep 2026, Sierra.ev Jun 2026, Harrier shown in Geneva 2019 as Buzzard Sport) were already correct.
